messages:
juan (SI - Orion Systems): FYI running connector validation for RetailCo's private deployment. Marketplace image pulls are failing during preflight — blocking the final handoff. stack trace below, need help asap.

tara (PartnerEng): @juan can you paste the exact error and the kube/node environment? :eyes: what's the customer proxy/registry config?

juan (SI - Orion Systems): logs from the node:```
time=2026-03-18T14:03:12Z level=error msg=\"pull failed\" image=ghcr.io/redwood/inference-connector:v1.2.0 status=403 detail=\"access to the requested resource is not authorized\"
kubectl describe pod connector-validator -n retailco: Warning Failed  Failed to pull image \"ghcr.io/redwood/inference-connector:v1.2.0\"
```
also customer runs an outbound proxy (BlueProxy) + company-wide egress ACLs. they say only https (443) allowed via proxy.

ellie (Eng): 403 from GHCR usually means auth/nexus token or proxy is stripping auth headers. Two things to check quickly: 1) can the node curl the registry through the proxy and preserve auth header? 2) are there any corporate TLS interceptors that require custom CA?

matt (Solutions): quick repro steps I gave them:
```bash
# run on customer jump host
curl -v -x http://proxy.corp:3128 https://ghcr.io/v2/ | sed -n '1,20p'
# try docker pull with explicit proxy settings
export HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:3128
export HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:3128
docker pull ghcr.io/redwood/inference-connector:v1.2.0
```
They ran the curl and got 200 for the registry root, but docker pull still fails.

tara (PartnerEng): ok that matches the pattern: registry root allowed but docker client uses bearer auth and the proxy is probably removing the 401->401 challenge flow. Ask them to enable transparent passthrough for registry auth or configure proxy to allow "WWW-Authenticate" headers. Also, do they have a private registry mirror?

juan (SI - Orion Systems): They don't have a mirror. Customer security team says they can't change the proxy policy without an exception ticket (2-3 days). Go-live timeline slips.

ellie (Eng): short-term workaround: we can provide a tarball of the connector image (docker save -> .tar) for them to load on nodes, or host the image on a registry their proxy allows (e.g., their internal nexus) if they can accept it. Longer-term we need marketplace docs updated for environments with strict proxy/auth flows.

matt (Solutions): I'll draft an exception playbook: (1) image tar distribution; (2) signed checksum + verify step; (3) instructions for local registry import; (4) optional script to retag and push to internal registry. This should be < 1 day ops work.

tara (PartnerEng): Good. @ellie can you produce the minimal image export checklist and the verification hash? Also we should add a note in the SI runbook about proxies that rewrite headers.

ellie (Eng): Will do. checklist will include: required image list, docker save/load commands, expected digests, post-install smoke test (curl /health + example inference). I'll attach the snippet to the ticket.

sre-oncall-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-2026-0318-connector-registry-blocker assigned to eng-sre-team. Pinged on-call.

juan (SI - Orion Systems): thanks everyone — I'll tell the customer the options. For transparency: they prefer the tar import route. I'll coordinate acceptance testing and schedule a time for the node imports.

tara (PartnerEng): thanks @juan. I'll update the partner handoff doc and add a short section on "proxy-auth pitfalls" and the emergency tarball process. Will mark this as an implementation escalation for Partnerships. :white_check_mark:

matt (Solutions): if they pick the tar route we should also provide the installer script to automate checksum verification + systemd unit to start the connector. Reduces risk.

ellie (Eng): adding one more note — make sure the connector version is pinned in the deployment config (no auto-latest) otherwise the import will mismatch after future updates.

juan (SI - Orion Systems): copying the customer's PM here via DM. Will update this thread after imports/testing. Thanks all! :pray:
